description: This file provides utility functions for reading file contents into memory and printing input/output data, primarily used for unit testing purposes in the 'ut_test_common' module. It includes functions to read a file into a memory buffer and to print file content and key-value pair data.

methods.name: int read_file_into_memory(const char * filename,test_ut_memory_t * pInstance)
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a specified file into memory, storing it in a buffer within a provided struct, with error handling for file operations.

methods.name: void print_input_output(char * kvpData,const char * filename)
methods.description: Prints the content of a file (read into memory) and a given key-value pair data string, with formatted output sections.
